title: Members
description: People who can access {workspace}, their role and what they can see.

forbidden.title: You can't manage members
forbidden.description: Ask a workspace owner or admin to invite people or change roles.

scope.limited: {companies, plural, one {# company} other {# companies}}, {projects, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}

empty.title: No members yet
empty.description: Invite colleagues to answer questions, upload evidence or review results.

changeRole.title: Change role of {name}
changeRole.description: The new role applies to their next request.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: {name} ({email}) loses access to this workspace until reactivated. Their answers and files stay.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: {name} ({email}) gets back their previous role in this workspace.

remove.title: Remove {name} from this workspace?
remove.description: {name} ({email}), a member since {since}, loses access immediately. Their past answers and files stay. To bring them back, invite them again.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
revoke.description: The link sent to {email} stops working.

error.forbidden: You can't make this change. You can only grant roles up to your own, and you can't change your own role.
error.lastOwner: A workspace must keep at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
error.limit: Your plan's user limit is reached. Remove members or upgrade the plan to invite more.
error.notFound: This member or invitation no longer exists. Refresh the list.

invitation.emptyDescription: Accepted invitations appear under Members; new ones show here until accepted.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.description: Each person gets an email with a link that's valid for 7 days.
invite.emailsHint: Separate addresses with commas or new lines (up to {max}).
invite.invalidEmails: One or more addresses aren't valid email addresses
invite.tooMany: You can invite up to {max} people at once
invite.send: {count, plural, =0 {Send invitations} one {Send # invitation} other {Send # invitations}}
invite.scopeNote: Invitees get access to the whole workspace. Limiting access to specific companies or projects arrives with Companies and Projects.

roleHelp.workspace_owner: Full control, including billing and deleting the workspace.
roleHelp.workspace_admin: Manages companies, people, projects, surveys and suppliers.
roleHelp.contributor: Answers assigned questions, uploads evidence and enters KPI data.
roleHelp.auditor: Read-only access including evidence and the audit trail, for external assurance.

csv.description: One person per row, up to {max} rows. Separate several company or project ids with ;
csv.invalid: The file has errors. Fix them and upload it again.

results.title: Invitation results
results.summary: {invited, plural, one {# invitation sent} other {# invitations sent}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} one {, # already a member} other {, # already members}}.
